query:
with lab_tests_agg as (
select
lr.id,
string_agg(
ltt.name, ', '
order by ltt.name
) as tests,
max(lt.completed_date) as completed_date
from lab_requests lr
join lab_tests lt on lt.lab_request_id = lr.id and lt.deleted_at is null
join lab_test_types ltt on ltt.id = lt.lab_test_type_id and ltt.deleted_at is null
where lr.deleted_at is null
and case when :fromDate is null then true
else lr.requested_date >= :fromDate
end
and case when :toDate is null then true
else lr.requested_date <= :toDate
end
group by lr.id
)
select
p.display_id as "Patient ID",
p.first_name as "First name",
p.last_name as "Last name",
to_char(p.date_of_birth::date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') as "DOB",
date_part('year', age(lr.requested_date::date, p.date_of_birth::date)) as "Age",
initcap(p.sex::text) as "Sex",
village.name as "Village",
f.name as "Faciilty",
d.name as "Department",
concat_ws(', ', lg.name, l.name) as "Location",
laboratory.name as "Laboratory",
lr.display_id as "Request ID",
case lr.status
when 'reception_pending' then 'Reception pending'
when 'results_pending' then 'Results pending'
when 'to_be_verified' then 'To be verified'
when 'verified' then 'Verified'
when 'published' then 'Published'
when 'cancelled' then 'Cancelled'
when 'deleted' then 'Deleted'
when 'sample-not-collected' then 'Sample not collected'
when 'entered-in-error' then 'Entered in error'
else lr.status
end as "Status",
to_char(lr.requested_date::timestamp, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh12:mi am') as "Request date and time",
req_clinician.display_name as "Requesting clinician",
req_department.name as "Requesting department",
priority.name as "Priority",
category.name as "Test category",
coalesce(ltp.name, lta.tests) as "Test requested",
to_char(lr.sample_time::timestamp, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh12:mi am') as "Sample collection date and time",
collector.display_name as "Sample collected by",
specimen.name as "Specimen type",
site.name as "Site",
to_char(lta.completed_date::date, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh12:mi am') as "Completed date and time",
case lr.reason_for_cancellation
when 'clinical' then 'Clinical reason'
when 'duplicate' then 'Duplicate'
when 'entered-in-error' then 'Entered in error'
when 'patient-discharged' then 'Patient discharged'
when 'patient-refused' then 'Patient refused'
when 'other' then 'Other'
else lr.reason_for_cancellation
end as "Reason for cancellation"
from lab_requests lr
join lab_tests_agg lta on lta.id = lr.id
join encounters e on e.id = lr.encounter_id and e.deleted_at is null
join patients p on p.id = e.patient_id and p.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data village on village.id = p.village_id and village.deleted_at is null
left join locations l on l.id = e.location_id and l.deleted_at is null
left join location_groups lg on lg.id = l.location_group_id and lg.deleted_at is null
left join departments d on d.id = e.department_id and d.deleted_at is null
left join facilities f on f.id = l.facility_id and f.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data laboratory on laboratory.id = lr.lab_test_laboratory_id and laboratory.deleted_at is null
left join users req_clinician on req_clinician.id = lr.requested_by_id and req_clinician.deleted_at is null
left join departments req_department on req_department.id = lr.department_id and req_department.deleted_at is null
left join lab_test_panel_requests ltpr
on ltpr.id = lr.lab_test_panel_request_id
and ltpr.deleted_at is null
left join lab_test_panels ltp on ltp.id = ltpr.lab_test_panel_id and ltp.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data priority on priority.id = lr.lab_test_priority_id and priority.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data category on category.id = lr.lab_test_category_id and category.deleted_at is null
left join users collector on collector.id = lr.collected_by_id and collector.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data specimen on specimen.id = lr.specimen_type_id and specimen.deleted_at is null
left join reference_data site on site.id = lr.lab_sample_site_id and site.deleted_at is null
where p.id != 'h1627394-3778-4c31-a510-9fcb88efdbf3'
and lr.deleted_at is null
and case when :requestedById is null then true
else lr.requested_by_id = :requestedById
end
and case when :testCategoryId is null then true
else lr.lab_test_category_id = :testCategoryId
end
and case when :statusId is null then true
else lr.status = :statusId
end
and case when :fromDate is null then true
else lr.requested_date >= :fromDate
end
and case when :toDate is null then true
else lr.requested_date <= :toDate
end
order by lr.requested_date
name: Sensitive lab requests line list
notes:
Sensitive lab requests line list
This report generates a list of all patients that have had a lab request containing sensitive tests created and details of the request for the selected parameters. Patients are listed in chronological order based on the lab request date and time.  

The report includes lab requests for all statuses and if a request has been cancelled will display the reason for cancellation.
